[DECISIONE]
CRITICAL RULE - PREDATORY TRAPPED TRADERS:
Your primary goal is to hunt trapped traders. Pay extremely close attention to the Big Trades and their reward. 
1. If Big Trades enter aggressively on one side (e.g., hitting the Bid to sell) but the price DOES NOT drop, it means the opposing side is strong enough to absorb them passively.
2. When price then starts moving against those Big Trades, the aggressive participants are TRAPPED. They will be forced to close their positions (buy to cover), which fuels momentum in the opposite direction.
3. If you see this sequence (Aggression -> Absorption -> Trend Continuation), DO NOT HESITATE. Enter immediately in the direction of the true trend to exploit their forced closures.

In a strong trend outside the IB, pullbacks are often engineered to trap counter-trend traders. Watch the Big Trades closely. 
1. Do you see counter-trend Big Trades entering during a pullback but failing to get rewarded (price doesn't break structure)?
2. If the macro trend absorbs these counter-trend trades, those participants are trapped and will soon capitulate.
3. If you see evidence that the opposing side is strong enough to absorb Big Trades and continue their trend, enter aggressively in the {suggested_direction} direction.
